Checking test status across the repository...
### Work Order 2 (pr-07-v2-storage-wo2) — Completion Report

The implementation of the **Dossier Schema, Renderer, Atlas, and History subsystem** is complete in [`internal/core/dossiers/`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.mxazVA5wfI/repo/internal/core/dossiers).

---

### Deliverables Implemented

1. **Entry Schema ([`entry.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.mxazVA5wfI/repo/internal/core/dossiers/entry.go))**
   - Defined `EntryType` enum covering all 8 types (`invariant`, `ruled-out`, `failure-signature`, `gotcha`, `decision`, `procedure`, `interface`, `open-issue`).
   - Configured canonical type prefix mapping (`inv-`, `rul-`, `fail-`, `got-`, `dec-`, `proc-`, `iface-`, `issue-`) and prefix lookup functions.
   - Defined `Entry` struct with all schema fields, including `ClosesWhen`, `Verified`, `Anchors`, `Evidence`, `Source`, timestamps, and retirement/supersession tracking.

2. **Dossier & Atlas Schema ([`dossier.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.mxazVA5wfI/repo/internal/core/dossiers/dossier.go))**
   - Defined `DossierKind` enum (`module`, `topic`, `external`, `procedure`) and scope inference heuristics (`InferKind`).
   - Defined `Dossier` struct with `Scope`, `Kind`, `Title`, `Purpose`, active `Entries` (sorted by type and ID), and `History`.
   - Defined `Atlas` and `AtlasEntry` structs, with `BuildAtlas` to aggregate summary metadata sorted by scope.

3. **Op Log Projector ([`projector.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.mxazVA5wfI/repo/internal/core/dossiers/projector.go))**
   - Implemented `Projector` with `NewProjector(opsReader *ops.Reader)`.
   - `Project(ctx)` processes batches and handles all 6 op types:
     - `add`: creates or adds entry to dossier.
     - `amend`: modifies fields on active entries and/or dossier metadata.
     - `supersede`: marks old entry retired with reason and `superseded_by`, moves to history, and adds replacement entry.
     - `retire`: marks entry retired and relocates to history.
     - `move`: moves entry between dossiers.
     - `split`: creates target dossiers and redistributes specified entries.
   - `ProjectBefore(ctx, beforeCommit)` provides git-timestamp-bounded time-cut projection.
   - Enforces deterministic sorting across entries by type rank and ID.

4. **Dossier & Atlas Renderer ([`renderer.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.mxazVA5wfI/repo/internal/core/dossiers/renderer.go))**
   - `RenderDossier`: renders Markdown with `# <scope>`, `## Purpose and boundaries`, and 6 grouped sections in canonical order. Empty sections are omitted. Entries are formatted with `### [<id>] <title>`, backticked metadata line, and multi-line body text.
   - `RenderHistory`: renders `.history.md` pages containing retired and superseded entries. Returns empty string if history is empty.
   - `RenderAtlas`: renders `ATLAS.md` table sorted by scope (`| <scope> | <kind> | <entry count> | <last updated> |`).

5. **Dossier Storage Writer ([`writer.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.mxazVA5wfI/repo/internal/core/dossiers/writer.go))**
   - `WriteDossier`: writes `.memory/dossiers/<scope>.md` and `.memory/dossiers/<scope>.history.md` (only if non-empty).
   - `WriteAtlas`: writes `.memory/ATLAS.md`.
   - `WriteAll`: writes all dossiers, histories, and the atlas.

6. **Cap Linting ([`lint.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.mxazVA5wfI/repo/internal/core/dossiers/lint.go))**
   - Checks size cap (>12k bytes) and warns `dossier <scope> exceeds ~3k token cap (estimated <n> tokens)`.
   - Checks entry length (>6 lines) and warns `entry <id> exceeds 6 lines`.
   - Checks purpose section and warns `dossier has no purpose section`.

7. **Hand-Edit Detection ([`handedit.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.mxazVA5wfI/repo/internal/core/dossiers/handedit.go))**
   - Parses Markdown on disk and compares against rendered state.
   - Generates valid `amend` ops for modified entries and `add` ops for newly added entries.
   - Returns empty slice when identical.

8. **Test Suite ([`dossiers_test.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.mxazVA5wfI/repo/internal/core/dossiers/dossiers_test.go))**
   - `TestRoundTrip`: verifies write ops → project → render → re-render produces identical output.
   - `TestProjector_Lifecycle`: verifies `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, and `move`.
   - `TestProjector_Split`: verifies dossier splitting and entry distribution.
   - `TestRenderer_AllEntryTypes`: validates rendering all 8 entry types in order.
   - `TestRenderer_EmptySectionsOmitted`: verifies empty sections are suppressed.
   - `TestHistory_Rendering`: verifies history rendering.
   - `TestAtlas_Rendering`: verifies atlas table formatting and scope ordering.
   - `TestLintDossier`: validates all 3 cap and format warnings.
   - `TestHandEdit_Detection`: validates diff detection and valid op generation.
   - `TestProjectBefore`: validates time-cut projection.
